questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Tolerance for physical density is often higher in traditional Indian collective culture compared to Western individualistic societies.
Statement II: High physical density in India completely eliminates all negative psychological consequences of crowding across all settings.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

detailedSolution:

Statement II is incorrect because excessive density still produces adverse psychological stress, sensory overload, and task impairment when spatial resources are severely compromised.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Tolerance for physical density is often higher in traditional Indian collective culture compared to Western individualistic societies.
Statement II: High physical density in India completely eliminates all negative psychological consequences of crowding across all settings.

In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid NCERT facts erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is true while Statement II contains an error.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Statement I is correct because collective cultural socialization in India fosters greater acceptance of close interpersonal physical proximity in festivals, joint families, and markets. Statement II is incorrect because excessive density still produces adverse psychological stress, sensory overload, and task impairment when spatial resources are severely compromised.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
